causes.label: Water supply line may be clogged
remedies: Check water supply line.
You may need a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Water supply line may be clogged"

causes.label: Certain water conditions in combination with some detergents tend to darken aluminum
remedies: Scour all surfaces with a soap-filled pad.
Try another dishwasher detergent.
Cascade®, Cascade® Complete and Electrasol® Automatic Dishwashing Detergents have been approved for use in all GE dishwashers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Certain water conditions in combination with some detergents tend to darken aluminum"

causes.label: Low inlet water temperature
remedies: Make sure inlet water temperature is correct.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Low inlet water temperature"

causes.label: Rinse agent dispenser is empty
remedies: Check the rinse agent dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Rinse agent dispenser is empty"

causes.label: Improper rack loading
remedies: Load items to permit proper drainage.

causes.label: HEATED DRY OFF is selected
remedies: Select HEATED DRY ON.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "HEATED DRY OFF is selected"

causes.label: Inlet water temperature is below 120°F
remedies: Raise the water heater temperature to 120°F.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Inlet water temperature is below 120°F"

causes.label: Water pressure is temporarily low
remedies: Turn on a faucet.
Is water coming out more slowly than usual?
If so, wait until pressure is normal before using your dishwasher.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Water pressure is temporarily low"

causes.label: Air gap is clogged
remedies: Clean the air gap.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Air gap is clogged"

causes.label: Improper rack loading
remedies: Make sure large dishware does not block the detergent dispenser or the wash arm.

causes.label: Detergent
remedies: Use the correct amount of dishwasher detergent that is fresh and dry.
Cascade®, Cascade® Complete and Electrasol® Automatic Dishwashing Detergents have been approved for use in all GE dishwashers.

causes.label: Iron deposits in water supply
remedies: Install an iron filter in the water supply line.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Iron deposits in water supply"

causes.label: Combination of soft water and too much detergent
remedies: This is called etching and is permanent.
To prevent this from happening, use less detergent if you have soft water.
Wash glassware in the shortest cycle that will get them clean.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Combination of soft water and too much detergent"

causes.label: Water temperature entering the dishwasher exceeds 150°F
remedies: Lower the water heater temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Water temperature entering the dishwasher exceeds 150°F"

symptoms.symptom: Black or gray marks on dishes

causes.label: Aluminum utensils have rubbed against dishes
remedies: Remove marks with a mild, abrasive cleaner.
Load items so that they do not touch.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Aluminum utensils have rubbed against dishes"
